title: Infant-directed speech does not always involve exaggerated vowel distinctions: Evidence from Danish
why_promising: Primary spontaneous Danish production from 26 caregivers; 9,267 vowel tokens were manually segmented in Praat. The paper reports raw vowel-formant data and analysis code publicly deposited on OSF, with raw/normalized F1/F2, vowel duration, pitch and articulation-rate analyses relevant to the warehouse.
open_question: Enumerate the OSF file tree and ingest the actual raw token/utterance tables before promotion. Audio/video are explicitly not public, so provenance must retain public derived-data files and authoritative study links rather than implying raw-recording availability.
